summary: READ-ONLY pre-release audit sweep, Section C (Core Gameplay) and Section D (Character Dialogue). All primary checks PASSED. Verified: menu load with 3 standard map cards + PLAY, READY state on all 3 maps (day/night/dusk) does not scroll/score before first tap, first tap starts run + removes TAP TO FLAP hint, crash produces Game Over overlay with PLAY AGAIN + REVIVE + MAIN MENU, PLAY AGAIN resets distance/score/chips to 0, MAIN MENU returns to menu, REVIVE continues same run (distance preserved 29m -> resumed at 44m), REVIVE only usable once per run (revive-button count=0 on 2nd crash). Roadman scripted dialogue lines fire exactly at correct thresholds: no bubble on READY, 'Wargwarn?' on first flap at ~1m, 'I said wargwarn fam?' at 49m (first frame after crossing 50m), "A'ight say less, deekhed" at 100m. Easy Mode DEV purchase simulator unlocks correctly, Roadman DEV purchase simulator unlocks correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: GameScreen.js loop uses `else if` for 50m/100m milestones (line 268-274). If distance jumps >50m in one frame (rare lag spike) the 100m line will be delayed to the next frame. Non-blocking, noted in iteration_29.
showScriptedLine() has fixed 2200ms timeout — if two scripted lines trigger within 2.2s (very fast distance jump), the earlier one is truncated. Not observed in practice. Non-blocking.
1000m blackout is code-reviewed only — no live QA confirmation was possible within web-preview auto-fly reach (~250-300m ceiling). Recommend a dev-only DIST_WARP debug key for future QA sessions.

Console shows a couple of RN-Web deprecation warnings (`props.pointerEvents`, `shadow*`, `textShadow*`) — cosmetic, not blocking Google Play submission but should be cleaned up before RN 0.75+ upgrades.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all tested checks (Section C: 13/14 PASS, 1 NOT TESTED = blackout@1000m; Section D: 7/7 PASS)
